query: framework jointly adapts simulated user environment rewards RL configuration
text:
1. **EAU: Environment-Agent-User Co-evolution for Training User-Centric Agents** — The closest match. EAU dynamically modifies the user simulator, environment, reward design, and RL configuration while training continues.  
   **People:** Min Cai and Xi Ye (University of Alberta; Xi Ye also Amii); Dan Zhang (National University of Singapore); Gao Xing and Libin Ma (Kuaishou Technology); Zhaohui Xu (independent researcher).  
   **URL:** [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16523)

2. **One Frozen Simulator Is Not Enough: Simulator Collapse in Multi-Agent RL** — Introduces SCOPE and co-training, in which the policy and trainable user simulators evolve together to prevent overfitting to one simulator.  
   **People:** Simon Yu and Weiyan Shi (Northeastern University); Nicholas Tomlin (New York University); Marwa Abdulhai and Sergey Levine (UC Berkeley); Ximing Lu (University of Washington); Derek Chong, Abe Hou, Dilara Soylu, and Christopher D. Manning (Stanford University).  
   **URL:** [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.12253)

3. **UserRL: Training Interactive User-Centric Agent via Reinforcement Learning** — A closely related framework combining standardized environments, simulated users, reward shaping, trajectory scoring, and GRPO configuration experiments.  
   **People:** Cheng Qian (Salesforce AI Research and UIUC); Heng Ji (UIUC); Zuxin Liu, Akshara Prabhakar, Jielin Qiu, Zhiwei Liu, Haolin Chen, Shirley Kokane, Weiran Yao, Shelby Heinecke, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, and Huan Wang (Salesforce AI Research).  
   **URL:** [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.19736)
